Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • ai: add localized continuation prompts for retry logic (2054f17)
  • git: support direct-path mode for Git status queries (1c1ee86)
  • application: integrate ProjectGitGrain cache for Git operations (5fb05f2)
  • orleans: add ProjectGitGrain for Git snapshot caching (70cf1b0)
  • web: update session controllers and subscription services (63b356f)
  • orleans: update session grains with concurrency policy support (62009c0)
  • domain: update message event contracts and storage (fed2325)
  • heroes: enhance hero service and license validation (ed5f99b)
  • concurrency: add session manager concurrency policy options (e2af667)
  • health: add model-aware health check with ping-pong validation (6de0859)
  • ai: add provider error auto-retry coordinator (d8d5488)
  • dlc: add trust handshake and signature verification enhancements (58990bd)
  • messaging: add MessageBucketGrain for hot-path message coordination (0865d71)

HagiCode-org/web

  • concurrency: add turbo-engine DLC resolution and concurrency utilities (fc88bb3)
  • hydration: add themed hydration reminder with multiple reminder styles (e8f218b)
  • utils: add utility functions for concurrency and proposals (68f27a9)
  • i18n: add locale entries for concurrency and review features (196573a)
  • statusbar: add achievement ambient particles (c3e515b)
  • wizard: enhance wizard setup step with improved UX (fb7759b)
